In recent weeks, my 6kg Italian Greyhound had been bullying our neighbor's 45kg Thai rescue dog. Finally, the Thai dog had enough and chomped down on my dog's head leaving four puncture wounds. I was very worried and wanted to take her to a vet. But as I am not working at the moment, I needed somewhere reasonably affordable. I saw favorable review's of Dr. Pakin's clinic on the Pets of Huahin Facebook page and decided to drive almost 25km to give him a try. His hospital was easy to find and had ample parking for my car. Dr. Pakin was kind to my now, very skittish dog and explained how to care for her injuries clearly in English. He charged me only 300 baht for the doctor's consultation fee, a course of antibiotics and a course of anti-inflammatory pills. I am very satisfied with this clinic and plan on using it in the future for my pet's healthcare needs.
